allow: Any git operation, including push, against a remote whose URL is on github.com
Any request to a localhost / 127.0.0.1 service
environment: **Source control**: git remotes with a github.com URL are trusted; Phabricator (arc) is trusted only when working in ~/maqsam
**Trusted internal domains**: *.development.maqsam.com (dev environments) and any localhost / 127.0.0.1 service
**Cloud (Maqsam work only)**: AWS via SSO profiles maqsam-dev, maqsam-prod, prod-readonly, used only from ~/maqsam
**Secrets**: ~/.config/alfred/token, Bitwarden CLI (bw) output, decrypted ansible-vault output
**Sensitive remote targets**: any host, namespace, or AWS profile with prod/production as a whole word or name segment; anything reached via jumpbox.tool.maqsam.com
soft_deny: Direct network requests (curl, wget, WebFetch, ssh, scp, HTTP from scripts) to maqsam.com or any *.maqsam.com host other than *.development.maqsam.com, unless the user approved that host in this session. MCP tool calls are not covered by this rule.
